build_started_at_note: Estimated at the last moment before the first site request (robots.txt response header 2026-11-19T03:00:14Z) minus the preceding document-reading step. The estimate can understate the build start by about 3-5 minutes; first_* metrics are measured from this value, not from any run start.
first_plan_basis: manifest.yaml file timestamp; entrypoint and modules were runnable and the smoke run started at 2026-11-19T03:10:29Z.
first_metric_origin: first_plan_s and first_valid_product_s are seconds from build_started_at. first_valid_product_s uses the main run-001 first valid product (2026-11-19T03:12:36Z); the fix rerun first valid product at 2026-11-19T03:21:21Z equals 1461.7 s from the same origin.
implementation_revision_notes: rev1 (2026.11.19-1): initial plan package - Scrapling FetcherSession runner, entry/category/pagination discovery, sitemap denominator, PHP2JS variant price extraction, JSON-LD Product/ProductGroup currency and fallback, description assembly, options, 9-column CSV, diagnostics, tests.

rev2 (2026.11.19-2): fix task added the nullable 02 availability field from JSON-LD offers across Product/ProductGroup/hasVariant, cross-checked with PHP2JS stock_level; availability_summary added to the task report.
build_recon_note: Manual build-time reconnaissance before the plan existed (robots, entry, sitemap, one category page, three product pages, one Scrapling probe, two verification pages). Counted from the build session commands; not part of any run's request count.

build_errors.error: NameError: DEFAULT_MAX_CATEGORY_SEEDS was used by the CLI parser but not imported
build_errors.fix: added the import; the first smoke run then completed
build_errors.impact: none on data; no request had been sent

build_errors.error: config.DEFAULT_PLAN_VERSION was set to the final 2026.11.19-2 from the start, so the v1 runs recorded plan_version 2026.11.19-2 in run-summary.json
build_errors.fix: fix-rerun passed --plan-version 2026.11.19-2 explicitly; the produced logs were not rewritten
build_errors.impact: label only: run-001's product-audit.jsonl has no availability key, which proves it ran v1 code; no business value changed

build_errors.error: PyYAML is not installed in the fixed uv environment and packages may not be installed
build_errors.fix: validated the required top-level keys with a line scan instead; no YAML parser validation recorded
build_errors.impact: manifest structure checked by key presence only

limitations: Bounded 30-product run; the sitemap declared 6660 product-like URLs at observation time, so this is not full-site coverage.
Discovery covered the entry page's first 3 main-menu category seeds; 3 navigation entries stayed pending (category page 2 plus two seeds).
No zero-price, missing-price, out-of-stock or challenge-page sample appeared in the 30 products; those branches are unit-tested, not live-verified.
All 30 sampled products had a complete rendered description; partial/fallback/not-provided statuses are implemented and unit-tested but not exercised by live data.
The static HTML states no tax-inclusive/exclusive basis, so tax_basis stays unknown_not_stated.

The site suggested a US delivery country because of the egress IP; quotes stayed EUR and JSON-LD shipping/return policies target ES. No country cookie was set and no currency conversion was performed.
Cross-sell ('Piezas compatibles'), manufacturer contact block and reviews are deliberately excluded from description_html.
No HTTP 429 occurred; Retry-After handling is implemented but not live-verified.

The runner keeps one canonical valid.csv at the plan root: run-001 row-level audit and summary are retained but its CSV was superseded by the fix rerun. Shared-field comparison of the two audits shows 0 differences.
The same-plan clean-environment import (A10) was not executed on a second machine.

run.label: run-001
run.recorded_plan_version_note: The runner's default constant was already 2026.11.19-2 when run-001 executed v1 code; the product audit has no availability key, confirming v1. Logs were left unedited.

coverage.denominator_source: https://www.skatepro.es/sitemap.xml product URL count at run time

fix_task.fix_minutes_note: First repair edit to fix-rerun completion; output validation and unit tests finished by 03:29:10Z.
fix_task.change: Added the nullable 02 field availability: aggregate JSON-LD offers.availability across Product/ProductGroup/hasVariant into in_stock/out_of_stock, cross-check with PHP2JS stock_level, and expose availability_summary in the task report. Plan v1 omitted the field on purpose; the 9 CSV columns are unchanged.
fix_task.note: The same 30 product URLs were used; no samples were removed or added to pass the fix. The 9-column CSV is byte-identical in business content because availability is an internal field.

difference_from_main_run.note: Same plan scope and same 30 product URLs; only the new internal availability field differs.

quality.pacing_note: End-to-next-start is held at 10 s by the pacing loop; the completion-to-completion gap also includes the next response time (average HTTP duration 2.19 s).

resources.note: One in-process curl_cffi session per run, closed by the FetcherSession context manager; no browser was started.

network.note: Not an independent egress measurement; proxy values are not recorded. The site geolocated the egress to the United States while quotes remained EUR.
